items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: deGaulle and the Americans wasn't buddies then

ctx.x: my special man. Yeah, he's my special man. It will all come back to me sometime.

Now, then I've got an idea to have business. See, this man coming in there with pheasants and all on his back, and counting money and everything, and when he first come in to sell it." there he was as poor as he could get. "Now we're going" In the meantime I met a man called Jean Paul Lauget (PHONETIC) from Belgium. And he said, why don't you come to Belgium and let us do business. We can open up a cabaret or whatever we want to do. And he said, the Americans are going -- deGaulle and the Americans wasn't buddies…
